correctness.rationale: Both admissibility conditions are factorial. Exhaustive one-bit extension is therefore complete, and every newly created violation must be a suffix. Exact suffix tests reject an antisquare of order at least 4 or a periodic suffix with 3L >= 8p. The regenerated counts end with 24 survivors at length 28, 8 at length 29, and 0 at length 30. A second whole-word pass checks every factor and every period of all eight extremizers. Symmetry recomputation gives two four-element reversal/complement orbits.
